title: Identification and Mechanistic Study of a Novel Keap1-Targeting Antioxidant Peptide From Ulva prolifera Protein.
authors: Zhu, Shaohui; Liu, Shanglian; Yao, Huashan; Fang, Lan; Xu, Hongbo; Li, Zhiyong
journal: Journal of peptide science : an official publication of the European Peptide Society
one_liner_zh: 该文研究多肽WDGL与Keap1蛋白的分子对接及抗氧化机制，虽涉及蛋白-肽互作，但对象为蛋白-多肽而非蛋白质-DNA，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作研究无关。
abstract: Activating Nrf2 by targeting the Keap1-Nrf2 signaling axis has emerged as a viable therapeutic approach for managing oxidative stress and its associated disorders. This study employed virtual digestion, ADMET profiling, and molecular docking to identify antioxidant peptides derived from Ulva prolifera protein. A novel tetrapeptide (WDGL) was ultimately discovered, demonstrating favorable aqueous solubility, non-toxicity, high intestinal absorption efficiency, and blood-brain barrier permeability. WDGL established four H-bond interactions with some key sites of Keap1 (Arg380, Arg415, Ile416, Leu365). Besides, WDGL reduces ABTS.(+) and ferric-tripyridyltriazine (Fe(3+)-TPTZ) in vitro and promotes the expression of GSH-Px while increasing GSH-Px and SOD enzyme activity to eliminate ROS in LPS-treated EA.hy926 cells. Furthermore, this peptide could reduce the content of ROS and ET-1 in Ang II-induced EA.hy926 cells. The result suggested that WDGL may alleviate EA.hy926 oxidative damage by activating the Keap1-Nrf2 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 通过靶向Keap1-Nrf2信号轴激活Nrf2已成为管理氧化应激及其相关疾病的一种可行治疗策略。本研究采用虚拟消化、ADMET分析和分子对接技术，鉴定源自浒苔（*Ulva prolifera*）蛋白的抗氧化肽。最终发现一种新型四肽（WDGL），其具有良好的水溶性、无毒性、高肠道吸收效率及血脑屏障通透性。WDGL与Keap1的若干关键位点（Arg380、Arg415、Ile416、Leu365）建立了四个氢键相互作用。此外，WDGL在体外降低ABTS.+和铁-三吡啶三嗪（Fe(3+)-TPTZ）水平，并在LPS处理的EA.hy926细胞中促进GSH-Px表达，同时提高GSH-Px和SOD酶活性以消除ROS。进一步地，该肽能降低Ang II诱导的EA.hy926细胞中ROS和ET-1的含量。结果表明，WDGL可能通过激活Keap1-Nrf2信号通路减轻EA.hy926氧化损伤。
